Smaller fixes after 1.1.0.

**Use it now:** [vemsavad.promptagency.se](https://vemsavad.promptagency.se) (Chrome or Edge).

### Fixed
- An old or mistyped link to a page that doesn't exist (`/some/old/path`) gave a blank page; it now goes
  to the start page — online and offline.
- The word list suggests more misheard names: a name run together into one word ("Vemsavad" for
  "Vem sa vad?") and two swapped letters ("plausibel" for "Plausible"), with no new false suggestions in
  a 40,000-word test.
- If speaker separation runs out of memory, the message is now in the interface language.
- Choosing another model while a file is in progress now says the change applies from the next file.
- If the tab was hidden while transcribing, the app explains why it went slowly: browsers slow down hidden
  tabs.

### Hosting it yourself
`vem-sa-vad-v1.1.1.zip` below is the built site. The `.htaccess` no longer sends unknown paths to the app
(which left them blank); they get a normal 404. See
[docs/hosting.md](https://github.com/promptagency/vem-sa-vad/blob/main/docs/hosting.md).
